description: This is a minimalist, white armchair with a clean, modern design. It features a sturdy frame with thin arms and legs, providing a light and airy aesthetic. The seat and back are upholstered in a complementary white fabric, creating a seamless look. A single white throw pillow is placed on the seat, adding a touch of comfort and visual interest. The overall design emphasizes simplicity and elegance, making it a versatile piece for various interior settings.
